# The Criminal Mind Preliminary shot coverage

Original screenplay: Baldadoon. Adaptation and direction: CFA Nova. Revision v001, 2026-10-30. All additions are Preliminary; PH Claude has not reviewed or adopted this pass and requests to him remain paused.

165 proposed coverage shots across 41 source-scene groups. These are authored shot plans, not generated clips, accepted artwork or a locked runtime. The 41 original source blocks remain intact. The later flashback and return inside TCM-S40 are explicitly labelled within the coverage.

This screenplay is dialogue-first. A coverage shot can span a conversation that will require several generation segments after a scratch performance. Five-minute reel/chapter divisions, if useful for browsing, must be derived from that timing rather than treated as five-minute shots. No master score or soundtrack has been supplied.

Every card uses the shared 16-field Structure & gaps model. Lighting, camera, acting and prompt text below are proposals. Casting, set selection and starting frames remain missing; provider settings, returns and human acceptance are not assessed. Kitchen is an unfilled final-delivery stage, not a ready package.

Source excerpts are in the original readable script and the JSON record; no dialogue has been silently rewritten. Camera cuts do not remove source text.
